# apple_age_rating_declaration (Resource)

Answers the age rating questionnaire, from which App Store Connect derives the app's age ratings. Only the answers set here are sent. Changes apply to the declaration of the version being prepared and need a version in an editable state. Destroying the resource leaves the answers as they are. Import it by app ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_age_rating_declaration" "example" {
  app_id                      = data.apple_app.example.id
  violence_cartoon_or_fantasy = "INFREQUENT_OR_MILD"
  gambling                    = false
  user_generated_content      = false
  messaging_and_chat          = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

- `advertising` (Boolean) Answer for `advertising`. Unset answers keep their current value.

### Read-Only

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_age_rating_declaration.example
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_age_rating_declaration.example 1234567890
```
